subject: Security discovery: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & trust portal access
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Price <lauren.price@cardiacai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security discovery: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & trust portal access

Hi Lauren — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we stay aligned: 

1) Scope & compliance needs (you confirmed): SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter for interim coverage, HIPAA considerations for PHI flows, and EU data residency for a subset of analytics exports.
2) What we need from CardiacAI to proceed:
   - A contact on your security/legal side to receive the Vendor Security Questionnaire (VSQ) and coordinate bridge letter LOA (we can accept a legal PO/LOA).
   - Confirmation whether any PHI will reside in EU regions or if EU processing is limited to pseudonymized analytics.
3) From Redwood: we can provision temporary attestation and a Trust Portal view for CardiacAI while you complete the VSQ. We will also share our SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter template.

Immediate asks: can you confirm the security/legal contact (name + email) and whether EU data residency applies? If possible, we’d like to provision portal access today and kick off the VSQ so we can hit a target turnaround of 7–10 business days for the evidence review.

Attaching a draft bridge-letter template and a short temporary attestation we can post to the portal while your team completes the questionnaire.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a VSQ invite and portal link once I have the security contact.

Best,
David
David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: bridge_letter_template.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: redwood_temp_attestation.pdf (pdf)

From: Lauren Price <lauren.price@cardiacai.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security discovery: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & trust portal access

Thanks David — great session. A couple clarifying items before you spin up the portal and VSQ: 

- Please confirm exactly which artifacts you need from us versus what Redwood will supply. For example: do you need any environment diagrams or just the completed VSQ and legal LOA?
- HIPAA: yes, we will be processing PHI for U.S. patients. HIPAA controls are required.
- EU residency: we do have a small analytics export that must remain in the EU; we can flag it in the questionnaire.

Security/legal contact is Michael Lawson (michael.lawson@cardiacai.com) — he handles vendor intake and contracts. He’s out of office tomorrow but can review early next week.

Timeline: can you provide an ETA for when a portal invite hits Michael and an expected window for the SOC 2 Type II report sighting (we’ll need the bridge letter to satisfy procurement for an internal pilot)? Also, do you offer an SFTP or secure upload fallback if we can’t use the portal immediately?

— Lauren
Lauren Price
Head of Product Security | CardiacAI
lauren.price@cardiacai.com

Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security discovery: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & trust portal access

Hi Lauren / Michael — looping Michael per Lauren’s note. 

Short answers: we will provide the following from Redwood: SOC 2 Type II report (PDF), a signed bridge letter/LOA (PDF) for interim coverage, and a temporary attestation we can post to the Trust Portal while the VSQ is completed. Items we need from CardiacAI: completed VSQ, environment/network diagram if you have one (optional but speeds review), and confirmation of the EU-residency subset.

Actions I’ve taken:
- Sent VSQ invite to Michael (link below). The VSQ is a short intake; expected completion time ~45–60 minutes.
- Provisioned a temporary Trust Portal invite for CardiacAI: https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/invite/XY7Q-CardiacAI (invite expires in 7 days).
- Attached: redwood_temp_attestation.pdf, bridge_letter_template.pdf, and a small file with the VSQ invite info (vsq-invite-link.txt).

If you prefer a secure upload instead of the portal, we can enable SFTP for uploads (we keep those logs for audit and can provide transfer receipts). Let me know which your team prefers.

Next steps for our timeline: once VSQ is complete we’ll triage artifacts and aim to have formal evidence review started within 3 business days; bridge letter signed within 24 hours of acceptance. If you need a copy of the full Type II immediately, we can share that under an NDA/portal access as part of the same flow.

Thanks — I’ll stand by for Michael’s confirmation and any LOA details.

Best,
David

Attachments: vsq-invite-link.txt (text), redwood_temp_attestation.pdf (pdf), bridge_letter_template.pdf (pdf)
VSQ link: https://redwood.ai/vsq/start/RDW-4392

David — small ask: can you also send a DocuSign link / LOA template we can sign electronically if that speeds procurement? Otherwise we’ll plan to return the VSQ answers by EOD Friday and confirm preferred upload method (portal vs. SFTP).

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Lauren
